scope: shared API SQLite file permissions and read-only audit process permissions; no scientific or runtime source revision
reason: SQLite initially creates the API database as 0640; a read-only worker with another UID can create 0640 WAL sidecars that deny the broker its next write; concurrent observers can extend the lifetime of those sidecars
shared_storage: only the new continuous API database and its WAL/SHM use 0660 in their existing shared research group; broker ExecStartPre preserves the main database mode; no SQL records, owner, budget or legacy path changes
sqlite: observer opens mode=ro and sets its effective group to the existing common ledger group and umask 0007 before any SQLite open; the observer itself never chmods/chowns files; only the separate authorized storage repair sets shared modes
group_guard: worker and shared API database must have the same existing group; otherwise fail before SQLite open
validation: native separate-user regression reproduces the failure when the worker reads a 0640 API database, then proves a concurrent broker writer succeeds after the new shared database is 0660; observer remains mode=ro
